prompt:
Create a respectful, recognizable modern textbook portrait illustration of Mikhail Lomonosov (1711-1765).

Use the supplied historical portrait only as an identity and facial-feature reference. Preserve the person's recognizable face, hairstyle, age impression, and general pose. Render a head-and-shoulders or upper-torso portrait in a polished full-color educational illustration style on a clean white background. Use restrained natural colors and crisp edges.

This must clearly read as a newly created textbook illustration, not an archival photograph. Use simple civilian or scholarly clothing without military insignia, medals, flags, uniforms, political symbols, or national emblems.

No text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, signatures, Cyrillic, Chinese characters, handwriting, decorative Soviet symbols, old-book texture, halftone dots, monochrome engraving, frames, or extra people.
